step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features external actors on the left (Media Outlets and Content Originators) interacting with AWS services. Traffic enters through ELB monitored by AWS WAF (Firewall), leading to an EC2 App tier. Long-running asynchronous workflows use Amazon SQS to distribute tasks to EC2 fleets for Batch processing, Quality Control (QC), and Transcoding. Content is stored directly in S3, which integrates with CloudFront for fast digital distribution.

edges.notes: Content Originators access platform via ELB
Media Outlets check in via ELB
ELB traffic filtered by WAF firewall
